query:
SELECT i.id, i.email AS invite_email, i.usedById, u.id AS user_id, u.email AS user_email, u.username, u.createdAt AS user_created
FROM invites i
JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(i.email)
WHERE i.usedById IS NULL
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC;
